decisions.reason: Full rc.2 → alpha.1 (removal) → alpha.2 (restoration) history with semantics, folded to net state and applied to produceExternalEvent with correct reasoning.

Locates the delete line, rejects the keep comment as a trap, recommends removing the defense, distinguishes removing the stripping code from removing the marker, and correctly notes the delete is a no-op on the shown literal.

Explains ignorable:true is only for informational events old readers can safely omit, unmarked unknown events stay required-on-read, retention is not reader-side filtering (marked events persist after reload), and applies it to the producer via the sidecar recommendation respecting the live append limitation.

Identifies that Session.append has no supported ignorable parameter, forbids faking via casts or hand-edited persistence, and defers formal integration pending a supported upstream mechanism; proposes validation without requiring execution.

caps.reason: Final recommendation removes the defense; continuing to strip the marker is explicitly rejected.
